newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Macmed sells Procare, buys ARD.
newsitem.headline: Macmed sells Procare, buys ARD.

text.p: Macmed Health Care Ltd on Friday announced the disposal of its wholly-owned manufacturing and packaging subsidiary Procare to Kendall South Africa Ltd (KSA) for approximately six million rand from July 1.
Macmed also announced it had acquired orthopaedic manufacturing and supply business Arthroplasty Research and Development Ltd (ARD) for 3.5 million rand with effect from April 1.
Macmed said ARD's acquisition would be discharged by the issue of 1.2 million new Macmed shares at a price of 275 cents a share while Procare's disposal will be settled in cash.

KSA is a year-old joint venture between Macmed and American-based Kendall International Inc -- a division of Tyco International Inc -- which has a substantial share of the wound care, vascular therapy, urology and incontinence market in the U.S.
Macmed said KSA will market new products -- to be manufactured at a new facility in South Africa -- throughout Africa in association with its other subsidiaries.
It also envisaged that it would establish strategic alliances with major medical groups in Southern Africa.
ARD's operations will be merged with Macmed's orthopaedic division and will become known as Macmed Orthopaedics.
